verdict.rationale: Wise Business supports exporting statements in accounting-friendly formats (CSV, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF) and offers webhook subscriptions for transaction events, which could enable syncing with accounting software, but there is no explicit evidence of a native/automatic integration with specific accounting platforms (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero) or a documented sync feature. Missing for 10: named accounting-software integrations (QuickBooks/Xero/Sage), automatic sync setup docs, and independent confirmation of real-world use for accounting sync.
